android.desc:
Join thousands of players in the most popular Polish word game! Literaki is a Scrabble-style board game — place words on the board, score bonus points with unique color-matching tiles, and challenge opponents from around the world.

Play fast 3-minute matches or take your time with longer games lasting days. You can also play offline against the computer when you're on the go.

Red on red? Triple points!
Every tile has a color — white, yellow, green, blue, or red. Match the tile color to the board space and triple its value! A red letter on a red space? That's 5× the points. Play all 7 tiles at once for a 50-point bonus!

Who will you challenge today?
Take on friends, random opponents, or the AI at 3 difficulty levels. Choose between two board layouts — Literaki or Szkrable. Create a table, send invitations, or join an open game — there's always someone ready to play.

SJP or OSPS? You choose
Choose between Słownik Języka Polskiego (SJP) or Oficjalny Słownik Polskiego Scrabblisty (OSPS) — the official tournament dictionary. Only Literaki gives you this choice.

Word of the Day — something new every day
Discover the Word of the Day — a new word every day to expand your vocabulary. Check word definitions right from the board. Every game makes you a better player!

Your toolkit
Chat during games. Review the best possible move after each turn. Check remaining tiles and plan your strategy. Track your stats and climb the top 100 rankings. Shuffle your rack tiles as many times as you want.

Lost? One-tap rematch!
Challenge your opponent to a rematch and show what you're made of. Join the Literaki League and Facebook community — connect with word lovers just like you.

Download for free and play your first game. Your move!

Privacy policy and terms of use:
https://www.literaki.com/privacy
